messages:
Priya Rao: FYI — EdgeCost sent our renewal quote. ~18% list increase and a new line for 'priority routing' that wasn't in last year
Ben Carter: ugh. Can you paste the quote? or a screenshot?
Priya Rao: pasted the relevant lines below:
```
EdgeCost Renewal Q1 2026
- Base subscription (Enterprise) : $22,500/mo
- Priority routing add-on     : $4,050/mo
- Overages (embedding API)    : $0.0025 per embedding
- Annual discount applied?    : 0% (term: 12 months)
```
Maya Liu: Where did we land last year on committed spend? I thought we had a 10% renewal discount for a 12m commit.
Priya Rao: we committed $240k last year, got 10% off. This quote looks like they removed the discount and added the addon.
Jonah Park: billing-bot — can you confirm last year's invoice totals and contract terms? @billing-bot
billing-bot: Automated note: Contract #EC-RED-2025 shows committed ARR $240,000 with 10% renewal credit applied on 2025 renewal. Last year's total invoiced (net) = $216,000.
Ben Carter: OK, two asks: 1) procurement to push for reinstating 10%/multi-year discount, 2) Ops to get usage reconciliation on that new 'priority routing' metric — why are they charging it now?
Maya Liu: +1. Also want a breakdown of monthly embedding usage for the last 6 months to model overage risk.
Priya Rao: I'll open an SOW/renewal thread with EdgeCost. Can someone draft a short email to ask for: a) point-by-point justification of priority routing, b) historical usage tieout, c) reinstated discount or multi-year pricing?
Ben Carter: I can draft. Proposed subject: "EdgeCost — renewal questions and usage reconciliation". I'll ask for a line-item tieout and any migration credits.
Jonah Park: Procurement note — do not approve any auto-renew with that addon enabled. Need explicit confirmation we accept addon.
Maya Liu: If they insist on addon, ask for feature parity in SLA (latency improvement %?) or a 6mo trial at no charge.
Priya Rao: Thanks. Ben, cc me and procurement@redwood when you send. I'll attach the current invoice and last year's signed contract.
Ben Carter: Will do this afternoon. @billing-bot can you attach invoice PDF 2025-12 and contract EC-RED-2025 to the thread for reference?
billing-bot: Attached: invoice_2025-12.pdf, contract_EC-RED-2025.pdf :white_check_mark:
Maya Liu: Quick calc — if they keep base + addon at listed prices, annual cost = (22,500+4,050)*12 = $318,600. That's +47% from our net last year. Need to push hard.
Priya Rao: Good catch. That delta is unacceptable. Let's aim for either reinstate 10% + remove addon, or keep addon and get 20% discount on total.
Ben Carter: Drafted email ready, posting here before send for quick edits:
```
Hi Team,
We received the renewal quote for EC-RED-2026. Can you please provide:
1) Line-item justification for the new "priority routing" charge and historical usage tied to its billing metric.
2) Embedding API monthly usage for the last 6 months to validate overage calculation.
3) Confirmation of any available renewal discounts for a 12- or 24-month commitment and any migration/feature credits.
We cannot approve an auto-renew with the addon enabled without explicit consent.
Thanks,
Ben Carter (on behalf of Redwood Inference)
```
Jonah Park: looks good. Add a sentence requesting a 30-day pricing hold while we reconcile usage.
Ben Carter: added and sending now. I'll post their reply in thread.
Priya Rao: Perfect — thanks all :thumbsup:
